name: Aura Score Analyzer
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt-get update && sudo xargs apt-get install -y < packages.txt || true; python -m pip uninstall -y tensorflowjs tensorflow-decision-forests tensorflow-hub || true; python -m pip install --user --upgrade pip; python -m pip install --user --upgrade -r requirements.txt; echo 'Packages installed and requirements met'
